title: India, 1945
tagline: A war ends, a famine is reported and the Simla Conference fails.

locale.persona: an urban household in British India (typical, not one named family)
locale.placeNameNote: Period place names with today's name in brackets on first mention, e.g. Bombay (now Mumbai).

morningRoutine.detail: Zeenat, with its qawwali, was the highest-grossing Indian film of 1945.
The first edition of R. K. Narayan's novel The English Teacher appeared in 1945.
IPTA, formed in Bombay on 25 May 1943, took theatre to audiences with themes from the freedom struggle and, after the famine, the plight of Bengal.
Bombay beat Holkar by 374 runs in a timeless final played from 4 to 9 March 1945.
